why.statement: Most of us know what good practice looks like. The harder part is applying it — in a real organisation, with real people, on an ordinary Tuesday. Ignite2Flourish connects workplace best practice and research with *22 years of lived experience* in HR.

pillars.title: Experience
pillars.text: Lessons from local, regional and global HR leadership roles across Australia, the UK, Hong Kong, New Zealand, Indonesia, Bangladesh and Pakistan.

pillars.title: Evidence
pillars.text: Books and research papers read closely, summarised fairly, and kept separate from opinion.

pillars.title: Application
pillars.text: Practical ideas for professionals who want to progress — and for those who feel a little stuck, or are simply going with the flow.

exploring.intro: Two questions I keep returning to at the moment. Updated as my thinking moves on.

items.title: Hiring for potential, not just experience
items.note: Why do so many organisations still hire for an exact role match — and what would it take to select for learning, collaboration and the ability to lead change instead?

items.title: From languishing to flourishing at work
items.note: The space between ‘not unwell’ and ‘thriving’ is where many capable professionals live. What moves people out of it — and what keeps them there?

exploring.invite: A question from your own working life, a study worth reading, a book that changed your mind — suggestions shape what I explore next.

startHere.intro: New here? Three pieces that show what Ignite2Flourish is about — one from each theme.

conversation.headline: Agree? Disagree? Have an experience that complicates the argument?
conversation.text: Ideas get better in conversation. Write to Sanzid directly — to respond to an article, explore a collaboration, or ask about a podcast, panel or speaking opportunity.

footer.statement: An independent publication on leadership, careers and flourishing at work.
